grounding.states: Best insured (high-ratio) 5-year fixed rate in Canada is 4.34%
grounding.from: Ratehub lists the best high-ratio (insured) 5-year fixed rate in Canada at 4.34%.
Wowa gives the same 4.34% as the lowest insured 5-year fixed rate.
Ratehub's table (updated October 13) shows a Big 6 bank at 4.54%

grounding.states: Fixed rates have been rising since early September
grounding.from: Rates are climbing in October 2026, after all six of the largest banks raised select fixed rates since early September.

value.answer: There's no single 5-year fixed rate. It depends on the lender and on whether the mortgage is insured (under 20% down). The lowest insured 5-year fixed I can find is 4.34%. For uninsured I couldn't pin down a lowest figure I'd stand behind. The big banks are higher, with one at 4.54% and Scotiabank at 4.74%. Fixed rates have been climbing since early September.
